description: This file is a bundled JavaScript module for a minification utility using Terser, part of a Webpack build process, exporting minify and transform functions.

methods.name: buildTerserOptions
methods.description: Builds and normalizes Terser minification options based on provided settings.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is an object or function.

methods.name: buildComments
methods.description: Constructs a comment handler function for extracting and preserving comments during minification.

methods.name: minify
methods.description: Performs minification on input code using provided options or a custom minify function.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Evaluates a string of code into an internal minify configuration and executes minify.
